text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today we're testing the results of our
ongoing
experiments!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You're prepared, aren't you? I'm going
to need
you to record everything!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
That's what I like to hear! I'm pretty
excited as
well!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what type of results will be
produced
from all the work we've done.
